## New module: `src/datahub/cli/sso_cli.py`

- **`browser_sso_login(frontend_url, duration, timeout_ms=300000, support=False) -> tuple[str, str]`** — Launches a headed Playwright Chromium browser at `{frontend_url}/login`, polls the browser context for the `PLAY_SESSION` cookie to detect login completion, extracts the `actor` + `PLAY_SESSION` cookies, URL-decodes the `actor` value into the `actorUrn`, copies every cookie onto a `requests.Session` via `session.cookies.set()`, then calls `listAccessTokens` (for the warning) followed by a `createAccessToken` mutation at `{frontend_url}/api/v2/graphql`. Returns `(token_name, access_token)` where `token_name` starts with `"cli token"`.
  - Raises `SsoLoginError("SSO login timed out …")` on timeout (closing the browser first via `finally`).
  - Raises `SsoLoginError("… no actor cookie found …")` when the actor cookie is absent.
  - Raises `SsoLoginError("Failed to create access token: …")` when the GraphQL response has `errors`.
- **`_check_playwright_ready()`** — verifies Playwright is importable (patchable in tests), raising a helpful install message otherwise. Called first inside `browser_sso_login`.
- **`_warn_about_existing_cli_tokens(session, frontend_url, actor_urn)`** — queries `listAccessTokens`, counts tokens named `cli token…`, prints a warning containing `{count} existing CLI token(s)` and `{frontend_url}/settings/tokens`, and suppresses all exceptions.
- `sync_playwright` is imported at module level (guarded), so tests can patch `datahub.cli.sso_cli.sync_playwright` even when Playwright isn't installed.

## `src/datahub/entrypoints.py` (the `init` command)

- Added `--sso` and `--support` flags.
